name: heat-trace
title: Heat Trace
desc: The remocn wordmark is traced in a warm-to-cool gradient heat line, with a tagline beneath.

name: hex-fill
title: Hex Fill
desc: A hexagonal grid fills with gradient cells up to an 86% reading.

name: hidden-word
title: Hidden Word
desc: A word is found hidden inside a sentence and lifted out as a large italic title.

name: high-score
title: High Score
desc: A pixel arcade table inserts a new top entry, 'NEW HIGH SCORE', above four lower scores.

name: hologram
title: Hologram
desc: Play a scene as a projection: a ghost double shimmers off the image, emission lines structure it, and only what is bright enough carries through the dark volume it hangs in.

name: home-widget
title: Home Widget
desc: A home screen widget is added and shows a weekly renders chart above app icons.

name: hook-punch
title: Hook Punch
desc: A two-beat hook stops the scroll, then a gradient payoff lands: 'This video took 1 day.'.

name: hook-uncurl
title: Hook Uncurl
desc: Stacked condensed caps lines uncurl into place, ending on 'Just make the video.'.

name: hot-slab-morph
title: Hot Slab Morph
desc: A hot-coloured slab morphs into a prompt card under the line "or just describe it".

name: hot-stage
title: Hot Stage
desc: A short line, 'Clear the tower.', beside a faint mono mission log of timed stage events.

name: hyperspace
title: Hyperspace
desc: A deterministic starfield stretches into radial streaks, the scene tunnels forward and a white flash at the cut reveals the next scene.

name: icon-activity
title: Activity
desc: Animated Lucide activity icon — the pulse line sweeps through like an EKG, popping at the peak. Loops by default.

name: icon-alert-triangle

name: icon-arrow-down

name: icon-arrow-left

name: icon-arrow-right

name: icon-chevron-up

name: icon-cloud

name: icon-gem

name: icon-gift

name: icon-heart

name: icon-image

name: icon-inbox

name: icon-info

name: icon-send
